LanguageData.Ratkin_GuerrillaCA.description: [PAWN_nameDef] hailed from a small village that was plundered by a passing warlord. [PAWN_pronoun] fled [PAWN_possessive] homeland amidst the screams of [PAWN_possessive] mother.
LanguageData.Ratkin_GuerrillaCA.title: Ratkin Refugee
LanguageData.Ratkin_GuerrillaCB.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born in an underground base of the Ratkin Underground Partisans. [PAWN_pronoun] found everything on the surface utterly novel.
LanguageData.Ratkin_GuerrillaCB.title: Ratkin Underground Child
LanguageData.Ratkin_GuerrillaCC.description: In underground life Insect Jelly was one of the few delicacies for [PAWN_nameDef] and the Ratkin Underground Partisans. Children would take great risks for these precious treats and no one could stop them.
LanguageData.Ratkin_GuerrillaCC.title: Insect Jelly Thief
LanguageData.Ratkin_GuerrillaCD.description: While navigating through the tunnels [PAWN_nameDef] once fell into a bizarre Pit Gate. Fortunately before the Dreadmeld could react [PAWN_pronoun] fled in panic.
LanguageData.Ratkin_GuerrillaCD.title: Ratkin Child Fearing Fleshbeasts
LanguageData.Ratkin_GuerrillaCE.description: The underground watercourses are of great value to the Ratkin Underground Partisans. [PAWN_nameDef] is the specialist in the driller squard entrusted with locating water sources.
LanguageData.Ratkin_GuerrillaCE.title: Groundwater Hunter
LanguageData.Ratkin_GuerrillaCF.description: The fish from underground rivers are among the few "conventional foods" for the Ratkin Underground Partisans. In [PAWN_possessive] view, edible meat comes in only two colours: green and white.
LanguageData.Ratkin_GuerrillaCF.title: Underground Fisher
LanguageData.Ratkin_GuerrillaCG.description: The biochemical weapon deployed by Noble Azalea proved pivotal to the Kingdom's success in the war, yet [PAWN_nameDef] had the fortune to endure the catastrophe.
LanguageData.Ratkin_GuerrillaCG.title: Ratkin Plague Survivor
LanguageData.Ratkin_GuerrillaCJ.description: All of [PAWN_nameDef]'s family succumbed to the plague. [PAWN_pronoun] was adopted by the Ratkin Underground Partisans. [PAWN_pronoun] harbours an instinctive fear of biochemical weapons, yet this ordeal has forged [PAWN_pronoun] into a more resilient individual.
LanguageData.Ratkin_GuerrillaCJ.title: Plague Orphan
LanguageData.Ratkin_GuerrillaCM.description: From a tender age, [PAWN_nameDef] began mastering the culinary arts. [PAWN_pronoun] can craft delightful meals from the most ordinary ingredients, rendering them a favourite amongst all.
LanguageData.Ratkin_GuerrillaCM.title: Underground Junior Cook
LanguageData.Ratkin_GuerrillaCN.description: Despite [PAWN_possessive] young age, [PAWN_nameDef] has already acquired fundamental defensive skills. [PAWN_pronoun] is often stationed at the watch post, maintaining a vigilant observation of the surroundings.
LanguageData.Ratkin_GuerrillaCN.title: Ratkin Junior Guard
LanguageData.Ratkin_GuerrillaCP.description: Within the underground mineral veins, [PAWN_nameDef] stands as the most diligent miner among the children. [PAWN_pronoun] possesses the ability to accurately identify optimal excavation sites for ore deposits.
LanguageData.Ratkin_GuerrillaCP.title: Ratkin Junior Miner
LanguageData.Ratkin_GuerrillaCQ.description: [PAWN_nameDef] delights in perusing the limited collection of books within the Ratkin Underground Partisans. [PAWN_pronoun] harbours a profound yearning for knowledge and often poses inquiries that even adults find challenging to address.
LanguageData.Ratkin_GuerrillaCQ.title: Underground Junior Scholar
LanguageData.Ratkin_GuerrillaCS.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is charged with tending the mushrooms and lichens cultivated by the Ratkin Underground Partisans. [PAWN_pronoun] possesses an intimate knowledge of these underground crops, ensuring their flourishing even within impoverished soils.
LanguageData.Ratkin_GuerrillaCS.title: Underground Junior Farmer
LanguageData.Ratkin_GuerrillaCT.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is an apprentice mechanic in a factory. [PAWN_pronoun]'s talents were appreciated during the war, thus [PAWN_pronoun] assumed a vital position within the revolutionary army.
LanguageData.Ratkin_GuerrillaCT.title: Ratkin Apprentice
LanguageData.RKU_GuerrillaAA.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is a veteran who endured the revolutionary army era. [PAWN_pronoun] holds a profound nostalgia for the military life under Acacia's leadership, until that plague extinguished all future hopes.
LanguageData.RKU_GuerrillaAA.title: Ratkin Partisan Veteran
LanguageData.RKU_GuerrillaAB.description: [PAWN_nameDef] formerly served as a guard to a noble. During the war, when [PAWN_possessive] master fled the manor by carriage, [PAWN_objective] was not taken along. Freedom is a blessing, is it not?
LanguageData.RKU_GuerrillaAB.title: Former Ratkin Guardener
LanguageData.RKU_GuerrillaAC.description: By dint of [PAWN_possessive] remarkable swiftness, [PAWN_nameDef] outran the contagion of the biochemical weapon and evaded the pursuing barrier troops. Under Sycamore's leadership, the revolutionary army became so disoriented that they even slackened their pursuit of deserters.
LanguageData.RKU_GuerrillaAC.title: Partisan Courier
LanguageData.RKU_GuerrillaAE.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a fortunate conscript on the Eastern Front during the war. [PAWN_pronoun] matured amidst the schism of the revolutionary army, and by virtue of that fortune, [PAWN_pronoun] steadfastly upheld the beliefs of those days. Although none can say what the future may hold.
LanguageData.RKU_GuerrillaAE.title: Partisan Commissar
LanguageData.RKU_GuerrillaAF.description: In this region, the Ratkin Underground Partisan leader was formerly an officer in the artillery unit, and [PAWN_nameDef] was one of her former subordinates.
LanguageData.RKU_GuerrillaAF.title: Partisan Commissar
LanguageData.RKU_GuerrillaAG.description: The local Ratkin Underground Partisan leader was an officer in the artillery unit, and [PAWN_nameDef] was one of her former subordinates.
LanguageData.RKU_GuerrillaAG.title: Partisan Commissar
LanguageData.RKU_GuerrillaAH.description: [PAWN_nameDef] served as a demolitions expert in the revolutionary army. [PAWN_pronoun] acquired mastery over the construction and deployment of various explosive devices, and within the underground base, [PAWN_pronoun] was frequently entrusted with maintaining those perilous weapons.
LanguageData.RKU_GuerrillaAH.title: Underground Demolitions Expert
LanguageData.RKU_GuerrillaAI.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is the most adept member of the Ratkin Underground Partisans at infiltration and intelligence gathering. [PAWN_pronoun] has repeatedly disguised [PAWN_objective] as a refugee to infiltrate enemy camps, bringing back valuable intelligence.
LanguageData.RKU_GuerrillaAI.title: Ratkin Infiltrator
LanguageData.RKU_GuerrillaAJ.description: During the plague's devastation, [PAWN_nameDef] served as a medical orderly and attended to innumerable compatriots. [PAWN_pronoun] possesses a wealth of experience with various pathogens and toxins, though this exposure has left [PAWN_pronoun] somewhat neurotic.
LanguageData.RKU_GuerrillaAJ.title: Ratkin Plague Medic
LanguageData.RKU_GuerrillaAK.description: [PAWN_nameDef] served as an elite sniper in the revolutionary army. [PAWN_pronoun] could precisely strike targets from hundreds of metres away, yet after the plague, [PAWN_pronoun] grew somewhat weary of taking lives.
LanguageData.RKU_GuerrillaAK.title: Ratkin Sniper
LanguageData.RKU_GuerrillaAL.description: [PAWN_nameDef] served as a mechanical maintenance soldier in the kingdom's army. During the war, [PAWN_pronoun] defected to the Ratkin Underground Partisans. [PAWN_pronoun] is now charged with maintaining the various mechanical equipment and weapons for the partisans.
LanguageData.RKU_GuerrillaAL.title: Underground Mechanic
LanguageData.RKU_GuerrillaAM.description: Within the underground base, the sustenance supply is of critical importance. [PAWN_nameDef] serves as the head chef, entrusted with converting an array of peculiar ingredients into palatable meals. [PAWN_possessive] culinary expertise has preserved numerous lives.
LanguageData.RKU_GuerrillaAM.title: Ratkin Master Chef
LanguageData.RKU_GuerrillaAN.description: [PAWN_nameDef] stands as the most accomplished excavation specialist within the Ratkin Underground Partisans. [PAWN_pronoun] excels at carving intricate tunnel networks through the most resilient rock formations, thereby providing considerable facilitation for the partisans' operations.
LanguageData.RKU_GuerrillaAN.title: Underground Miner
LanguageData.RKU_GuerrillaAP.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is entrusted with the defence of the Ratkin Underground Partisans' primary stronghold. [PAWN_pronoun] has repelled numerous enemy incursions and is a seasoned defence specialist.
LanguageData.RKU_GuerrillaAP.title: Underground Guard Captain
LanguageData.RKU_GuerrillaAQ.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was formerly employed at the kingdom's library, where [PAWN_pronoun] amassed a considerable body of knowledge. [PAWN_pronoun] now employs this learning to aid the Ratkin Underground Partisans in assessing hostile movements and devising tactical plans.
LanguageData.RKU_GuerrillaAQ.title: Ratkin Scholar
LanguageData.RKU_GuerrillaAR.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is a seasoned warrior, officer, and mechanitor.
LanguageData.RKU_GuerrillaAR.title: Partisan Officer
